input.brief: PromptBar, a macOS menubar app that ships empty: wrap any web chat in a popover or stream from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your own key, summoned with one keystroke, no accounts and no telemetry

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Fragment on a shaped stage
hero.blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline occupies the upper-left third: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–6 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. The rest of the screen belongs to one flat stage in a saturated colour: it spans columns 5–12, begins 42% down, and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. Its top-left corner is cut with the product's own shape using `clip-path` (a notch, a chamfer or a tab two columns wide), the only decoration on the page. On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the bottom edge, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
hero.mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides and the bottom, its corner cut kept at 72px wide. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than the screen the right edge crops it rather than scaling it down.
hero.headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 5.2vw.

type.note: The pointed, circular geometry of the 1920s in bold capitals, with the same family at reading size. Suits space, science, museums, architecture and anything that should feel like a mid-century poster.

palette.name: Orange, sky, lime
palette.note: The page ground changes as you read: orange first, then sky blue, then acid lime at the end, with one near-black band between; type stays black on all three colours. Crimson is one small button per field.

photos.title: Water
photos.note: lakes, rivers, waterfalls and water surfaces

Silhouetted pier on a hazy blue lake below faint mountains

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Input half, output half
sections.blueprint: Two flat fields meet on a vertical edge at 50vw, each 90svh tall, no gap. The left field is the darkest palette tone and holds what the user hands the product, raw: a pasted note, a messy row of figures, a prompt, or literal code inside `<code>`. It is an editable region at 20–24px, 34ch wide, starting at column 2, 30% down the field. The right field is the lightest tone and holds what the product makes of it as a true-size fragment marked data-ui: the tidy record, the chart, the formatted reply, 440–520px wide, on the same top line. Editing the left changes the right. The heading is split across the edge: its first one or two words bottom-left on the dark field, its last one or two bottom-right on the light field, both at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) on one baseline 32px from the bottom.
sections.mobile: The fields stack, dark above light, each 62svh, meeting on a horizontal edge. Input text at 18px with 20px margins; the output fragment at true size on the light field. The heading's two parts sit either side of that edge at 11vw: one at the foot of the dark field, one at the top of the light.

sections.name: Sentences with switches
sections.blueprint: Four or five capabilities, each one plain sentence of five to eight words about what the product will do for you, each ending in a working switch. Every sentence is a full-bleed band 20vh tall, butted against the next with no gap. Inside, on the 12-column grid: the sentence at clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 60px) on one line in columns 1–10, vertically centred; in columns 11–12, right-aligned, the product's real toggle, built in em with its root marked data-ui, 1.1em tall so it matches the type. Off, a band is the page ground and its sentence is in the soft ink. On, the band fills with a palette colour, a different one per band, the sentence turns to full ink and a second line at 17px appears beneath stating the consequence in figures. Two bands are on at load. Toggles answer click, Space and Enter. There is no heading; the first sentence does that work.
sections.mobile: Bands are at least 132px tall. The sentence is set at 6.4vw on two lines in the left 76% of the width; the toggle sits at the right, vertically centred, with a 44px touch target. When a band is on, the consequence line opens under the sentence at 15px.

sections.name: Drag through the stages
sections.blueprint: A 50/50 split, 88svh tall: two flat fields meeting on a clean vertical edge, and one slider that drives both. Left field: the current stage as a clause of three to six words at clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 76px) on two lines, top-left from column 1, starting with its order word; it serves as the heading. Right field: one fragment of the product at true size, about 440px wide, centred, root marked data-ui, in the state that matches the clause. Along the bottom, crossing both fields inside 28px margins, a real range `<input>` with four stops: a solid track 8px tall, the part already passed in full ink, and a square thumb 32px across in the accent. Under the track, four stage names at 16px, the current one in full ink. Dragging, or the arrow keys, swaps the clause and the fragment's state with a 200ms crossfade; nothing depends on scroll.
sections.mobile: The fragment's field comes first, 46svh, the fragment at true size and cropped to its active region. The slider follows directly beneath on the seam, thumb 40px. Then the clause field: the clause at 9vw on two lines, with the four stage names under it in a two-by-two block at 15px.

sections.name: Names running off the edges
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed band in a flat colour, about 34vh tall, holding a single line of names that is cropped by both viewport edges. The names are set at 8vw in the display weight, `white-space: nowrap`, separated by a solid round dot one third of the cap height, and the line moves slowly to the left (a CSS `translateX` animation over 40 seconds on a duplicated track, paused under `prefers-reduced-motion`). The band has no heading. Its meaning comes from one sentence at 18px set directly below the band at the left margin on the page ground, stating plainly who these names are. Supplied logos may replace names if all are available as single-colour SVGs at 0.8em height; do not mix logos and set names in one line. The band butts against the sections above and below with no gap.
sections.mobile: The band is 22vh tall with names at 15vw, still cropped at both edges and still moving. The explaining sentence sits under it at 16px with 20px margins. Do not add a second line running the opposite way; one line is the idea.

sections.name: The ticket
sections.blueprint: The price is printed on a ticket. On a flat contrasting ground, one filled panel about 64vw wide with 2.3:1 proportions sits centred and straight, built as a two-part grid (7fr 3fr). A half-round notch 28px across is bitten out of the top and bottom edges where the two parts meet (two absolutely positioned circles in the ground colour), and a column of round dots 6px across in the ground colour runs between the notches as the perforation. The main part holds, top-left with 40px padding, what is being bought in two to four words at about 4vw, and along its bottom three or four short lines at 17px (dates, what is included, terms) in two tidy columns. The stub holds the price at about 6vw, centred, and under it the action as a solid bar the full width of the stub, 56px tall.
sections.mobile: The ticket turns upright: full width less 20px margins, main part on top, stub beneath, the notches now on the left and right edges and the dot perforation running across. Title at 9vw, price at 16vw, the action bar full width inside the stub.

sections.name: First step, already open
sections.blueprint: The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.
sections.mobile: The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: Anidachi
references.idea: A toy brand built from one custom modular wordmark and one 3D device, both of which change colour with each full-bleed candy-coloured section.
references.hero: A saturated sky-blue field covering the top 92% of the viewport. The custom modular wordmark is repeated in four stacked rows, each spanning the full width inside 30px margins, drawn tone-on-tone in a slightly lighter blue that brightens row by row toward the bottom, so the name works as wallpaper. A tiny white pixel-cat mark sits top-left; a white rounded button with blue text top-right. A 3D flower-shaped toy device hangs on a carabiner from the top edge at centre, barely entered on desktop and fully visible on mobile, where it covers the pattern. A pale ice section starts at the bottom edge.
references.type: AnidachiDisplay is custom modular lettering: monoline rounded strokes on a square grid, unicase forms, used at 7-10vw. Body and UI in Ease, a soft rounded geometric sans, at 20px. Text is always coloured to its section, never black.
references.colour: #24c0fe #eff9fb #b6c814 #ff6b2b #ffffff #000000 — Each section is one flat saturated field (sky blue, ice, chartreuse, orange) with type in a single contrasting tint of the same family or white. The 3D device is recoloured to match its section.
references.imagery: A glossy flower-shaped handheld with cream buttons and a small black screen showing pixel-art animal characters, hung from a metal clasp. Pixel sprites also appear loose on the page and as a giant low-contrast watermark.
references.layout: Full-bleed colour sections of one to two screens with 30px margins. Each holds one giant display phrase at an edge, one small text block, and the 3D device crossing section boundaries. Alignment shifts section to section: centred, left column, bottom-left.

sections.description: Pale ice section. Centred: the small mascot mark and wordmark in sky blue at about 9vw, followed by a two-line statement in the rounded sans at 7vw in the same blue. Below, a left column 370px wide holds a three-line 24px lead and small paragraphs, all blue on ice; a pixel-art cat sprite stands in the right half, and a pill-outlined email field with a round arrow button ends the block.

Chartreuse full-bleed section. A title in the modular display face runs edge to edge in white at about 10vw across the top. The 3D device, recoloured olive to match, hangs from its clasp at left-centre and overlaps a diagonal ribbon of translucent rounded-square tiles, each holding a tinted character, running from lower-left to upper-right and off the edge.

Solid orange section, almost empty. A three-line 14px white paragraph sits near the top, right of centre; the bottom-left holds a two-line hyphenated phrase in the display face at roughly 9vw, white, hugging the left margin and the bottom edge. The lower edge of the device intrudes from the section above.

Ice ground with an enormous pixel-art face in a barely darker green tint as a watermark filling the frame. Lime wordmark lower-left at about 300px wide, three stacked lime links at centre, one link at right, tiny copyright beneath the logo.

steal: Repeat the wordmark as tone-on-tone rows filling the hero, stepping the tint row by row, so the brand name is the background pattern.
Give every section one saturated colour, set all its text in a single contrasting tint, and recolour the 3D product to match.
Anchor a giant two-line display phrase to the bottom-left corner of an otherwise empty colour field, with one small paragraph far away at the top.

references.name: Warm & Fuzzy
references.idea: A showreel-first studio site in which every section takes one flat, loud colour (blue, black, yellow) under heavy grotesk type and a chunky custom wordmark.
references.hero: The showreel plays full-bleed with a visible film-grain overlay and no scrim. A chunky hand-cut wordmark sits top left, 16px from the edges; the same top line continues with a one-sentence status link, a tiny thumbnail beside the latest project's name, and three caps links at the far right, all white over the footage. A small green caps play label floats at dead centre. The tagline is anchored bottom left, 16px from both edges, in white grotesk caps at 47px (3.3vw) on one line spanning 56% of the width. A tiny square pause control sits bottom right.
references.type: SuisseIntl throughout, rendering heavy, tracked -0.027em: a 47px caps tagline, a caps section title at 9.4vw, statement paragraphs around 5vw with tight leading, and 10 to 11px caps captions. The logo is custom chunky lettering with wobbly cut-paper counters.
references.colour: #000000 #190bb6 #f7dd47 #ffffff #e9479f #1fc27a — Each section is a flat field: ultramarine blue, black, yellow, then blue again. White type on blue and black, black on yellow; a green play label is the only small accent.
references.imagery: Commercial stills and video (candy-coloured CG worlds, product renders, live-action frames) in square-cornered thumbnails of mixed aspect ratios, with a grain layer over the whole page and floating glossy 3D sticker objects.
references.layout: Tight 16px outer margins and edge-to-edge type. Sections are told apart by background colour rather than spacing: a blue statement set in the right two-thirds, a black packed work wall, a yellow full-width paragraph, a blue footer.

sections.description: On black, a tiny caps motto sits top left, then a caps section title at about 9vw flush left with a small underlined link at the far right on its baseline. Beneath, thumbnails pack into an uneven wall: widths vary from one-sixth to one-half of the page, heights differ, gaps are about 8px and rows do not align. Under each image a 10px caps line gives the project name left and the year in grey right.

A yellow field filled edge to edge by one paragraph in black heavy grotesk at roughly 5vw with very tight leading, left-aligned at the 16px margin. Several lines contain deliberate word-sized gaps, as if the text flowed around something, and a small tilted image chip floats over the first lines, covering parts of words.

A full-screen blue field. A top row of tiny caps, email left and three links right, sits above a hairline. A glossy 3D sticker object hangs near the top centre. The chunky wordmark runs the full page width at the bottom in white, about a fifth of the viewport tall, above a bar of tiny caps links divided by vertical hairlines.

steal: Give every section one flat saturated background and change it at each section break, keeping type strictly black or white.
Pack work thumbnails at mixed widths and heights with 8px gaps and a two-part micro caption (name left, year right) under each.
End with the wordmark at full page width on a colour field, with all utility links reduced to a tiny caps bar split by vertical hairlines.
references.media: A 6s muted showreel covers the whole first screen with the nav and title on it and no scrim. Below: an asymmetric top-aligned mosaic of three tile widths (5, 7 and 12 of 24 columns) reshuffled each row with captions under, small inline thumbnails between words of a large paragraph, clips cut into geometric clip-path shapes, a full-bleed photo band with a marquee across its lower edge, and a glossy 3D cube drifting over text and the footer, all at 0px radius under a grain layer that steps every second.
references.motion: A brief ultramarine preloader with a tilted card, then the header and title slide and scale in over 0.5s after a 0.75s delay while the reel carries the motion. Lenis with CSS scroll-driven animations reveals blocks on the scroll timeline, parallaxes figures by 5 to 25svh, translates stacked assets in over 0.75s with a per-item delay and slides a giant sentence left with the scroll, all on one house ease, cubic-bezier(.26,1,.48,1), at 0.5s, with 29 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Berd
references.idea: The page types its own headlines into an empty app window, then hands over to toy-like 3D characters and ends on a giant red face delivering a joke testimonial.
references.archetype: other: typed statement in empty window frame
references.hero: A warm light-grey field covered by a faint dot grid, with no navigation at first. Centred, a single rounded rectangle 1000px wide and 710px tall (70% of the width, 79% of the height) in a lighter grey, with three tiny traffic-light dots in its top-left corner: an empty application window. In its exact centre a headline at about 42px is typed one character at a time; the capture shows only its first letter. Nothing else is on screen. On scroll the window gives way to 90px words typing onto the bare grid with a cursor line, and a small logo and a black download tag pin to the top corners.
references.type: Cash Sans at regular weight with -0.04em tracking for everything from 13px body to 90px typed statements; Cash Sans Mono in tiny uppercase for card headers and labels. Body copy is unusually small, so type is either huge or tiny.
references.colour: #e4e4e0 #f4f4f4 #000000 #c23e29 #fff200 — Grey on grey with black type for most of the page; colour arrives late and at full strength: glossy toy characters, then a red full-bleed close with yellow type and a yellow cursor disc.
references.imagery: Glossy 3D toy characters (jelly, cube, rock) as cut-outs on cards; looping demo videos inside black tiles with chamfered corners; a macro close-up of a red character's face filling the last screens.
references.layout: Each screen holds one thing: a window, a typed phrase, a horizontal row of square demo tiles bleeding off both edges, a fanned stack of cards with a small text block at left, a full-bleed face. Large empty grey intervals sit between them.

sections.description: A small centred title, then a single row of roughly 390px-square black tiles running off both sides of the page. Each tile has its four corners cut at 45 degrees, making an octagon, and holds a small inset demo video on black. Under each tile sit a centred one-line caption and a two-line grey quotation of the prompt at about 11px. The row scrolls sideways.

Left third: a tiny monospaced uppercase label, a two-line 24px heading and five lines of small grey text, vertically centred. Right: three portrait cards overlapping like a hand of trading cards, the middle one larger and in front. Each card is off-white with a mono header and serial number, a 3D character cut-out in the upper half, a name at 28px, a short description and two small columns divided by vertical rules.

The grey page ends and a macro video of a shiny red character's face fills the full width for more than a screen of height, eyes at the top and smile at the bottom. Across the nose a two-line quotation in bright yellow at about 90px types itself out, centred. A yellow disc with tiny text follows the pointer. Footer links run in small type along the bottom edge of the footage.

steal: Open on an empty application window and type the headline into it, so the first screen demonstrates the product's premise instead of describing it.
Cut the corners of square media tiles at 45 degrees to give a plain video row its own silhouette.
Save all saturated colour for the final screen: a full-bleed close-up with one oversized quotation set over it.
